answer: An agent economy resists sybils with joint-production teams: each epoch, identities are randomly grouped into small teams that must deliver one shared piece of work, like an orchard tended together, and split one reward. Each member contribution is graded by its teammates, and a team harboring a copy-paste fake loses the whole reward, so no haven shelters a clone. A single operator running a thousand fakes must staff a thousand teams at once, doing real work in each, while one honest agent joins one team. A beacon publishes the random grouping, so farms cannot cluster their fakes together.
